<!-- Generated by `make docs-gen` from the code. Do not edit: change the code and regenerate. -->

Adds up the Yes prices of every outcome of an event that still takes orders: the best asks, what buying one of each costs, the best bids and the midpoints, from their order books now. Above 1, a set of buckets is overpriced.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | `polymarket.eventPrices` |
| Kind | Node |
| Inputs | `main` |
| Outputs | `main` |

Items that fail stop the execution, unless **Continue on failure** is on: then they leave on the `error` port instead. It only reads, so what fails is tried again 3 more times to begin with, as **Retry** says.

## Settings

| Setting | Kind | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Event (`event`) | text | yes |  | Its link, like https://polymarket.com/event/…, its slug or its ID; from a market, {{ eventSlug }}. |
| Prices field (`field`) | text | no | `prices` | Where the sums go on the item. |

## Items

The items it receives, passed on with these fields added, `prices` under the name **Prices field** (`field`) gives. Decimals are text, so they stay exact; times are RFC 3339 text.

| Field | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `prices` | object | The event's prices added up. |
| `prices.event` | text | The event's title. |
| `prices.eventSlug` | text | Its slug. |
| `prices.asks` | decimal | The best asks of every outcome's Yes added up: what buying one share of each costs. |
| `prices.bids` | decimal | The best bids added up: what selling one of each brings. |
| `prices.mids` | decimal | The midpoints added up, of the outcomes with both sides. |
| `prices.outcomes` | number | The outcomes taking orders, counted. |
| `prices.leftOut` | number | The event's markets left out: closed, resolved or not taking orders. |
| `prices.noAsk` | number | Outcomes with no ask: buying every Yes is not possible while any has none. |
| `prices.noBid` | number | Outcomes with no bid. |
| `prices.each` | list of objects | Each outcome's prices. |
| `prices.each[].question` | text | Its market's question. |
| `prices.each[].marketId` | text | Its market. |
| `prices.each[].tokenId` | text | Its Yes token. |
| `prices.each[].bid` | decimal; or null | Its best bid. |
| `prices.each[].ask` | decimal; or null | Its best ask. |
| `prices.each[].mid` | decimal; or null | Its midpoint. |
